_README: The nightly regression gate fails the build if a run's execution_accuracy drops more than --max-regression (0.02) below the value above. That number is MODEL- AND SETTINGS-SPECIFIC: it was measured on gemma-4-31B at temperature 0.2. If the nightly runs a different model (the workflow defaults EVAL_MODEL to gpt-4o-mini) or different settings, regenerate this file from the first green CI run — run the suite, take execution_accuracy, and commit it here. Prefer temperature 0 in CI (the seed script's default) so the ~4-point run-to-run noise seen at temp 0.2 does not false-trip a 2-point gate.
